A very unimpressive spread!
Dec 2017 • Couples
This is supposed to be a seafood buffet, however there is just 1 seafood station and the selection is limited. The bulk of the buffet consists of starters such as cold cuts and cheese, salads, and main courses based on meat.
The chefs at the seafood station were very frugal with the squid and prawns. So much so that we have to make at least 3 trips to the station for more servings. The taste was good, however the beef we tried was terribly overcooked.
Most of the stations were replenished and service was very poor. I had to get up to ask for napkins and our plates weren't cleared between courses. The staff seem more concerned about setting up for breakfast rather than taking care of their current guests.

Superb quality, friendliness to match
Oct 2017 • Solo
Have a few days in Nha Trang at the start of annual holiday. Exploring for possible future trips. So staying at the ever reliable Novotel on the beach at Nha Trang. 

I've had two meals in the in house restaurant now. Both have been superb.

The evening seafood buffet is really quite special. Fresh. Variety. Prepared on the grill as you watch/listen/smell!

Meat options are available, again, grilled to perfection with fabulous marinades.

Free flow beer. Did I mention that? Free beer. Included.

Vnd 577 000.
20% discount for booking online.

Now to breakfast.

Just perfect. An extensive selection of dishes. Mix of culinary traditions. Prepared with love - you can feel it :)

And the two staff who looked after me. Di was attentive and patient with me, when I asked questions.

Lexi, the restaurant breakfast manager, took time to praise Di. A mark of a good leader.

More than a meal. A great way to spend your morning, watching the rest of Nha Trang go by...
